category_title: Low-proficiency students who experience high anxiety and lack of confidence due to linguistic barriers
scenario_title: Independent drafting and facing linguistic barriers in journal reflections
minimal_context: The student is writing a 300-word journal reflection on Blackboard about their linguistic challenges during their first year at the university.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please log into Blackboard and write your 300-word journal reflection about the language challenges you have faced during your first year at the university.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: This is my first year come to United States, so my English is not very good. I cannot remember many words and I do not know how to write so much words.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just write what you can for now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: When I write my essay, I meet many problems. My grammar is not very good. I look up the words in the dictionary, ask my roommate about my grammar.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Keep working on it and submit what you have.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I felt not good, I tried my best to write it but it was so bad. Although I was so unhappy, I knew it was my problem. I came back home to rewrite my essay.
